answer: Each bond is keyed to a hardware root, so one machine holds one bond. A failed audit slashes half of it. Replay catches duplicate work before payout. On a courier run that means one device, one route, one payout, and a rack of 100 clones needs 100 keys. The comet of cheap signups hits the ferrous root check and stops, while the glacier of pending audits keeps the farm's capital locked.
